basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Delhi Project Nurse II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One temporary Project Nurse-II post is open in the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Ansari Nagar, New Delhi, under the PrECISE research project (Project Code: I-2041). The post pays Rs 20000 + 30% HRA, with an initial engagement of 3 months that may be extended. A three-year General Nursing & Midwife (GNM) course with minimum second class or equivalent CGPA is essential, and the age limit is up to 28 years. Candidates may email a detailed CV to [email protected] latest by 10 November 2026 (5:00 PM).

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi
Preterm and LBW Care through Early CPAP, I-KMC/MNCU, Antenatal Steroids and Early Enteral Feeding (PrECISE); A Multicentric Implementation Research Study (Project Code: I-2041)
Initially 3 months; may be extended for the duration of the project (6 months extension)

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences is a medical institute located at Ansari Nagar, New Delhi: 110029. This post sits in its Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, under the PrECISE study, a multicentric implementation research study on the care of preterm and low birth weight (LBW) babies through early CPAP, I-KMC/MNCU, antenatal steroids and early enteral feeding.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Minimum Second Class or equivalent CGPA in a three-year General Nursing & Midwife (GNM) course. Experience in patient data collection. Experience in reviewing patient case sheets, medical records, exit records and other clinical documents. Basic computer proficiency, including MS Excel and data entry. Good communication and coordination skills. The age limit for the Project Nurse-II post is up to 28 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The maximum monthly emoluments for the Project Nurse-II post are Rs 20000 + 30% HRA, so the 30% house rent allowance is paid in addition to Rs 20000. The notice states that the salary will be as per ICMR guidelines. The engagement is purely temporary in the said project. The initial recruitment is for 3 months only. It may be extended for the duration of the project (6 months extension) based on satisfactory performance. The candidate engaged will have no claim for a regular appointment at AIIMS.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS New Delhi Project Nurse- II Job Description
content_sections.text: Collection of study outcome data from patient case sheets, medical records, exit records and other relevant clinical documents. Review and verification of patient records to ensure accuracy and completeness of study data. Extraction and documentation of relevant clinical and demographic information as per the study protocol. Coordination with hospital staff and concerned departments for timely access to patient records. Maintenance and updating of study-related records and data collection forms. Ensuring confidentiality and secure handling of patient information. Assisting the project team in monitoring data quality and resolving discrepancies. Performing other project-related activities as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Project Nurse- II
content_sections.text: The application is made by email only. The notice gives these instructions: Prepare a detailed CV. Write the name of the post and the project code clearly in the email subject line, for example "Project Nurse- II – I-2041". Send the CV to [email protected] . Make sure it is sent latest by 10 November 2026 (5:00 PM). Late, delayed, incomplete or unsigned applications will not be considered and will be rejected straight away without any correspondence. Detailed CV (with the application). Original certificates, to be brought at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened, and the date, time and mode of the interview will be intimated through email to eligible/shortlisted candidates only. Only shortlisted candidates will be communicated via e-mail to appear in the interview. No interview date is printed in the notice. No TA/DA will be given for attending.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Nurse-II vacancies has AIIMS New Delhi announced?
faq.answer: There is 1 Project Nurse-II post in the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology under the PrECISE project (Project Code: I-2041).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Project Nurse-II post?
faq.answer: The detailed CV must be emailed latest by 10 November 2026 (5:00 PM). Late or delayed applications will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the AIIMS Project Nurse-II post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is minimum Second Class or equivalent CGPA in a three-year General Nursing & Midwife (GNM) course. Patient data collection experience and basic MS Excel and data entry skills are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Project Nurse-II post?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 28 years, with upper age relaxation of up to 5 years for SC/ST and up to 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an AIIMS Project Nurse-II?
faq.answer: The maximum monthly emoluments are Rs 20000 + 30% HRA, and the salary is as per ICMR guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs 20000 pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states the pay as Rs 20000 + 30% HRA. No TA/DA will be given.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the AIIMS Project Nurse-II post?
faq.answer: Email a detailed CV to [email protected] by 10 November 2026 (5:00 PM), with the name of the post and the project code clearly mentioned in the subject line.

faq.question: Q8. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: The subject line must clearly mention the name of the post (Project Nurse- II) and the project code (I-2041).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Project Nurse-II post?
faq.answer: Eligible/shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, and its date, time and mode will be intimated to them by email only.

faq.question: Q10. Is the AIIMS Project Nurse-II post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary in the project, initially for 3 months, and may be extended for the duration of the project (6 months extension) based on satisfactory performance. It gives no claim for a regular appointment at AIIMS.
